messages:
ashok: Quick follow-up from the RFC — I want to float a focused refactor: move heavy compatibility checks into a deferred harness that runs post-ingest and only blocks routing for canary/slowpath traffic. Goals: reduce onboarding latency for fastpath while keeping full coverage over time.

marie: sounds promising. are you thinking of a separate service or a job in the intake pipeline?

ashok: separate job. lightweight preflight (smoke + fingerprint checks) stays inline. deferred harness = scheduled workers + streaming replay of representative inputs. we can then surface regressions via telem alerts instead of failing the ingest.

ben: tradeoff is clear: potential late-discovered incompatibilities. how do we make the risk acceptable for customers that require strict guarantees?

ashok: two levers: 1) route x% of traffic as shadow/canary to the new model until harness completes a confidence window. 2) provide a policy flag per-customer: strict_mode => block until harness passes all critical checks. default stays permissive for speed.

jia: can we keep the harness idempotent and resumable? if it crashes we should pick up where we left off. also need artifacts enough to reproduce failures locally.

ashok: yes — harness will checkpoint progress per-model-version (kv by model_fingerprint). artifacts bundle: model binary ref, golden-sample-set id, input-replay cursor, adapter-shim version.

ben: curious about golden sets. we should avoid huge corpora. proposal: stratified mini-bench sampler (N=2k) prioritized by token-length buckets, rare-token hits, and recent-production-signals. cost-estimate: ~2 GPUs for 3 hours per big model.

marie: can we simulate runtime environment? suspicious failures often only appear with runtime kv-cache/memory layout differences. harness should run on the same runtime profile (quant, seqlen, batch shapes) as target deployment.

ashok: agreed — harness runner will select runtime-profile matrix from model metadata. matrix example: ["quant:int8","seqlen:512","batch:1,8"]. runner will iterate combos but start with most-likely shapes (heuristic from traces).

jia: API/contract question: how do model adapters surface compatibility hints? currently adapter.verify(model_path) -> bool. we should extend to return an ordered list of soft failures with severities. like: [{"code":"IO_SHAPE_MISMATCH","severity":"critical","hint":"..."}].

ashok: proposed adapter contract string (informal):
```
adapter.check(model_ref) -> [ { code, severity: [critical,warning,info], reproducible_example } ]
```
harness will translate critical failures into canary-blocks if strict_mode on.

ben: what about telemetry hooks? need sample-level telemetry linked to sample ids and probe ids so we can triage quickly.

ashok: yep. every harness-run emits sample-level envelopes tagged: model_version, probe_id, input_id, runtime_profile, metric_set (latency,p99,token_loss,checksum). send to telem pipeline with a dedup key.

marie: ops question — who owns the golden-sample curation? ML infra or product? keeping it small+representative needs domain knowledge.

ashok: I'd start ML infra owning infra/ tooling, product/vertical teams own curated per-customer augmentations. infra provides sampler primitives and drift-detection hooks.

jia: for rollout UX, add an endpoint: POST /models/:v/submit-harness which returns job_id and estimated time. also GET /harness/:job_id to stream findings. consumers can poll or subscribe.

ashok: +1. smaller UX detail: include a `fastfail` param to run only critical checks when you want a quick safety gate.

ben: can we reuse existing bench infra? e.g., run `make mini-bench MODEL=$MODEL SAMPLES=2048 SEED=...` for harness jobs. less engineering sprawl this way.

ashok: yes, reuse bench worker pool. harness will orchestrate runs by submitting meta-jobs to bin/bench-orchestrator with the runtime-profile matrix.

oncall-bot: deployment note: bench-orchestrator is rate-limited by quota. Current queues: bench-prod-1 (capacity 8), bench-prod-2 (capacity 4). Please coordinate heavy runs with infra team. :warning:

marie: action items: 1) ashok draft RFC v2 with adapter contract + harness job API, 2) ben prototype sampler script + cost analysis, 3) jia wire simple REST endpoints and streaming logs. schedule sync next Tue.

ashok: assigned. I'll put a strawman RFC in docs and tag @infra and @security for perf and artifact-security concerns. thanks all :thumbsup:

jia: optional: add a small CLI helper for solutions engineers: `ri harness submit --fastfail --samples 500` so partners can run on demand.

ben: +1 — and capture run metadata in model-registry so results are queryable (pass/fail, last_run_ts, coverage_score).

ashok: good call. that'll be in the RFC. closing the loop — will post link to draft in this thread when ready.
